t: This is a sculpture called The Still Centre of the Turning World, standing at New Capital Quay in Greenwich. It was made by Dick Onians, an English sculptor born in 1940. Onians is the artist behind it, so the work here carries his hand. The title gives you something to think about as you walk around it, with the river and the quay moving past. I don't have more to tell you about how it was made or what it's built from, so let your own eyes do the work.
